title:
—Putana madonna, che ci dia i quattrini! Ho ragione? Culo rotto!
 
 —Intendiamoci. Mezzo sovrano più
 
 —Dice lui, pero.
 
 —Farabutto! Mortacci sui!
html_source:
Italian. Loosely translated:
-Madonna Putana, who give us money! Am I right? Broke ass!

-Mind. Half a sovereign more

-Says he, however.

-Rogue! Fuck on!

Or Gifford’s translation:

-Italian: “ -Whore of a Blessed Virgin, he must give us the money! Aren’t I right? Busted asshole! / -Let’s get this clear. Half a sovereign more… / -So that’s what he says, however! / -Half. / -Blackguard! His filthy dead [ancestors]! / -But listen! Five more per person…”
